budgetModel.taxRevenueFormula: GDP multiplied by the active game-model tax rate.
budgetModel.spendingFormula: For a country with a baseline budget balance, modeled spending equals modeled revenue minus that baseline balance. If balance is missing, use the configured game-rule deficit ratio.
budgetModel.transparency: Modeled fiscal flows are gameplay assumptions, not observed national budget data.

cashFlowPolicy.modeledTaxRevenue: Accrues to the live Treasury by simulated duration and is mirrored into finance.taxRevenue and finance.revenue.
cashFlowPolicy.plannedSpending: Annual budget allocation is a spending ceiling, not an automatic expense. Treasury falls only for actual Finance actions, external runtime outflows, and accrued debt interest.
cashFlowPolicy.externalSubsystems: Cash changes made by other ministries/resource/trade systems are reconciled from finance.available and recorded as externally classified credits/debits when the source action cannot be reliably inferred.
cashFlowPolicy.estimates: Country-sector output and projected tax contributions use finance_sector_registry_v1.json default shares and are game estimates, not observed statistics.
